== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Luke's Cape (Decipher Errata 1998)]] (<code>2_35-DE</code>, A New Hope, Light Side), showing the Decipher errata game text. No published image shows this text: the printed card ([[:File:ANH-L-lukescape-decipher-archive.gif]]) shows the original printed text of [[Luke's Cape]], and the Players Committee Holotable face ([[:File:ANH-L-lukescape.gif]], D-E1) shows the later PC errata text ("…your total Force generation is +1…").

* '''Text source:''' Decipher [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), "Luke’s Cape — Errata".
* '''Errata text:''' “Use 2 Force to deploy on a Rebel or alien. You may activate 1 extra Force each turn if Luke’s Cape is not at a Tatooine location. That character is immune to attrition < 3.”
* '''Made:''' 12 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker): the A New Hope card <code>2_35</code> (Decipher art from the art library, frame, title, lore, destiny 4, copyright line as printed; Decipher-style expansion sphere) with the errata game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Game text is re-typeset, so line breaks differ from any printed card; words are the Glossary's.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.
